title: Four ways to
make your store
work better.
intro: From building storefronts to diagnosing performance, conversions and technical health, I help ecommerce businesses solve what is really holding them back.

services.label: Build
services.title: Shopify Store Development
services.description: Build a Shopify store around your business requirements, customer experience and long-term scalability.
services.includes: Custom themes · Shopify Plus · Store architecture · Integrations
services.caption: Storefront architecture
services.imageAlt: A laptop showing a shoe store’s product grid on a travertine desk, beside potted plants and a vase of olive branches.

services.label: Measure
services.title: Performance & Lighthouse Audits
services.description: Find what is slowing the storefront down, from theme code and apps to images and third-party scripts, and fix what matters most.
services.includes: Core Web Vitals · Lighthouse reports · Theme and app impact · Speed fixes
services.caption: Performance diagnostics
services.imageAlt: A desktop monitor showing a speed gauge and bar charts on a wooden desk with open notebooks and a pen pot.

services.label: Improve
services.title: Conversion Rate Optimization
services.description: Identify friction across the customer journey, from product discovery to checkout, and turn it into clear, testable improvements.
services.includes: Journey analysis · Product page UX · Cart and checkout · Test ideas
services.caption: Customer journey
services.imageAlt: A tablet showing a conversion funnel and a heatmap, lying on linen with a green cloth, a brass key and a pencil.

services.label: Diagnose
services.title: Website Audits
services.description: Assess technical health, SEO and usability, with a prioritised list of what to fix and why.
services.includes: Technical SEO · Structured data · Accessibility · Code health
services.caption: Technical health
services.imageAlt: A laptop showing a page wireframe beside printed audit sheets, a magnifying glass and a terracotta mug.
